race.comment: DIRTY DIANA (9) has a race-fitness edge after winning at this track last start, overcoming a poor beginning and mid-race tightening before finishing powerfully. Should take beating again in a similar scenario. SUGAR SCHNAPPS (7) is going well having won strongly at Kilmore after a solid Tatura second. Harder now but respecting and she'll get the run of things up front. IL CIELO (1) resumes off a longer break, watch the market but he has the ability in this grade. AZZACOOL (8) was okay fresh at Mildura off a wide run and is a likely improver second up. CATWALK ICON (3) was beaten for speed over 955m fresh but is expected to improve here and take catching.
